questions.question: There are regions where farmers specialise in vegetables only. This type of farming is known as _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Truck farming.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Truck farming** is a type of farming where farmers specialize in **growing high-value crops **such as vegetables, fruits, and flowers.
 
• This type of farming is also known as **market gardening** or **commercial gardening.**
 
• The term** 'truck'** in truck farming refers to the old English word** 'truckle' **which means to **barter or exchange.**
 
• In truck farming, the** farmers grow crops **that are in demand in the** local market **and sell them directly to **consumers or to retailers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mixed farming** is a type of farming where** farmers grow crops** and **raise livestock** on the same farm.
 
• **Pastoral farming** is a type of farming where farmers raise animals such as **cattle, sheep, and goats** for their meat, milk, and wool.
 
• **Dairy farming **is a type of farming where farmers **raise cows or goats **for their milk.
 
• All these types of farming are different from truck farming as they **do not **specialize in growing high-value crops such as vegetables, fruits, and flowers.

questions.question:
Which of the following referred to as 'paper taxes'?

I. Wealth tax

II. Gift tax
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Both **wealth tax and gift tax** are referred to as **paper taxes** because they are** not widely enforced** and are often evaded by taxpayers.
 
• **Wealth tax** is considered a paper tax because it is **difficult to assess** the true value of an** individual's assets **and is often avoided through offshore accounts or other means of** hiding wealth.**
 
• **Gift tax i**s considered a paper tax because it is relatively easy to **avoid by transferring assets** in a way that does not trigger the tax.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wealth tax** is a tax on the net wealth of an** individual or organization,** including assets such as** cash, bank deposits, real estate, and investments.**
 
• **Gift tax** is a tax on the** transfer of property** by one individual to another, without receiving anything in return.

questions.question: Barakar is the tributary of which of the following rivers?

• The Damodar river is also known as the** "Sorrow of Bengal**" due to its** frequent floods** and devastating impact on the surrounding regions.
 
• The Damodar valley is an **important industrial region**, with **several coal mines and power plants **located along the river.

• The river has been heavily dammed and diverted for** irrigation and hydroelectric power generation**, which has led to several environmental and social issues.
 
• The Damodar valley is also known for its** rich cultural heritage**, with several ancient temples and archaeological sites located in the region.
 
• The** Kaveri river** is one of the most important rivers in **southern India**, flowing through the states of **Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.**
 
 
• It is also known as the **"Ganga of the South**" and is a major source of water for **irrigation and drinking purposes.**
 
 
 
• The **Krishna river** is one of the longest rivers in India, flowing through the states of** Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is an important source of water for** irrigation and hydroelectric power generation.**
 
 
 
• **The Ravi river **is a tributary of the** Indus river,** flowing through the states of **Himachal Pradesh and Punjab.**
 
 
• It is an important source of water for** irrigation and drinking purposes **in the region.
